description: Defensive deduplication does not define whether resolved_at and occurred_at precedence choose the earliest or latest timestamp, how null resolved_at sorts, or which public_ref direction wins. Duplicate rows with different semantic states can therefore select different winners and change numerator, denominator, components, and source linkage while conforming to this architecture.

evidence.snippet: The pure core additionally deduplicates defensive fixture/query duplicates by the same key using deterministic resolved_at, then occurred_at, then public_ref precedence.
